releaseNotes:
🚀 Continuous Chat & Menu Elegance Update (v1.1.3) by Dhiraj:
• 💬 Complete Chat Preservation: Fixes missing messages when continuing chatting; captures all messages exchanged from MessagingStyle notifications and eliminates count suffix fragmentation (e.g., 'Alice (2 messages)')
• 🛡️ Auto-Healing Conversations: Automatically merges previously fragmented chat threads and links user replies back into the active conversation
• ✨ Modern 3-Dots Popup Styling: Beautifully restyled overflow menu with rounded card corners, card elevation, item ripples, and organized categories
